description: Render an Arc diagram as a React component snippet, iframe embed, or standalone HTML page.

backgroundColor.description: CSS background color for format=html (defaults to the theme canvas)

baseUrl.description: Studio base URL for format=iframe (default: ARC_EDITOR_URL or http://localhost:5188)

componentName.description: Component function name for format=component (default: ArcDiagramExample)

dataName.description: Diagram const name for format=component (default: diagram)

format.description: Output format: component (TSX), iframe (embed tag), or html (standalone SVG page). Default: html

height.description: Iframe height in px or CSS percentage

includeGrid.description: Render the diagram grid for format=html (default: branded themes on, others off)

interactive.description: Whether the React component is interactive

mode.description: Color mode; defaults to the theme default

padding.description: Padding around the export bounds in px for format=html (default: 20)

sessionId.description: Session id for format=iframe URLs (generated if omitted)

theme.description: Arc theme id: default, warm, cool, mono, engineering, workbench, tactical, command, spacex, claude, codex, or inherit

title.description: HTML document title or iframe title

width.description: Iframe width in px or CSS percentage

name: render_html
